connectorTemplate.name: Google Ads
connectorTemplate.description: Manage Google Ads campaigns, ad groups, keywords, and performance reporting via OAuth2.

customer_id.description: Google Ads customer ID (required for API calls)

actions.name: list_ads
actions.description: List all ads in an ad group

body.query: SELECT ad_group_ad.ad.id, ad_group_ad.ad.type, ad_group_ad.status, ad_group_ad.ad.responsive_search_ad.headlines, ad_group_ad.ad.responsive_search_ad.descriptions FROM ad_group_ad WHERE ad_group.id = {{ String(args.ad_group_id) }} ORDER BY ad_group_ad.ad.id

actions.name: get_keyword_stats
actions.description: Get performance stats for a specific keyword

body.query: SELECT ad_group_criterion.keyword.text, ad_group_criterion.keyword.match_type, metrics.impressions, metrics.clicks, metrics.ctr, metrics.average_cpc, metrics.cost_micros FROM keyword_view WHERE ad_group_criterion.keyword.text = '{{ String(args.keyword_text) }}' AND segments.date DURING {{ String(args.date_range || 'LAST_30_DAYS') }}

actions.name: list_campaigns
actions.description: List all campaigns for a customer

body.query: SELECT campaign.id, campaign.name, campaign.status, campaign.advertising_channel_type FROM campaign ORDER BY campaign.id

actions.name: get_campaign
actions.description: Get a specific campaign by ID

body.query: SELECT campaign.id, campaign.name, campaign.status, campaign.budget_amount_micros, campaign.advertising_channel_type FROM campaign WHERE campaign.id = {{ String(args.campaign_id) }}

actions.name: list_ad_groups
actions.description: List all ad groups for a campaign

body.query: SELECT ad_group.id, ad_group.name, ad_group.status, ad_group.cpc_bid_micros FROM ad_group WHERE campaign.id = {{ String(args.campaign_id) }} ORDER BY ad_group.id

actions.name: get_ad_group
actions.description: Get a specific ad group by ID

body.query: SELECT ad_group.id, ad_group.name, ad_group.status, ad_group.cpc_bid_micros, campaign.id FROM ad_group WHERE ad_group.id = {{ String(args.ad_group_id) }}

actions.name: list_keywords
actions.description: List all keywords for an ad group

body.query: SELECT ad_group_criterion.keyword.text, ad_group_criterion.keyword.match_type, ad_group_criterion.status, ad_group_criterion.cpc_bid_micros FROM keyword_view WHERE ad_group.id = {{ String(args.ad_group_id) }} ORDER BY ad_group_criterion.keyword.text

actions.name: get_performance_report
actions.description: Get campaign performance metrics for a date range

body.query: SELECT campaign.id, campaign.name, segments.date, metrics.impressions, metrics.clicks, metrics.ctr, metrics.average_cpc, metrics.cost_micros FROM campaign WHERE campaign.id = {{ String(args.campaign_id) }} AND segments.date DURING {{ String(args.date_range || 'LAST_30_DAYS') }}

actions.name: get_ad
actions.description: Get a specific ad by ID

body.query: SELECT ad_group_ad.ad.id, ad_group_ad.ad.type, ad_group_ad.status, ad_group_ad.ad.responsive_search_ad.headlines, ad_group_ad.ad.responsive_search_ad.descriptions FROM ad_group_ad WHERE ad_group_ad.ad.id = {{ String(args.ad_id) }}

actions.name: pause_campaign
actions.description: Pause a campaign by updating its status
